mapper.select: SELECT files.ID id, files.JOB_ID jobId, files.JOB_SEQ jobSeq, files.PRODID prodid, files.PROD_NAME prodName, files.END_DATE endDate, files.START_DATE startDate, files.REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel, files.REVEAL_END_DATE revealEndDate, files.REP_TYPE rep_Type, files.REP_ID repId, files.REP_NAME repName, files.FILE_TYPE fileType, files.IS_CONFIRM isConfirm, files.IS_REVEAL isReveal, files.STATUS statu, info.TEMPLATE_ID templateId, info.TEMPLATE_PATH templatePath, info.TEMPLATE_NAME templateName, info.REPORT_NAME reportName, info.REPORT_TYPE reportType, info.REP_ORDER repOrder, info.REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory, prod.OPEN_MODE openMode, prod.PROD_TYPE prodType, prod.ISSUE_MODE issueMode, prod.ACT_MDATE actMdate, prod.SET_DATE setDate, prod.VDATE vdate, prod.MDATE mdate, prod.TERM term, prod.WINDUP_DATE windupDate, prod.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, prod.RAISE_TYPE raiseType, IFNULL(prod.RAISE_MIN,0) raiseMin, IFNULL(prod.RAISE_MAX,0) raiseMax, IFNULL(prod.RAISE_AMT,0) raiseAmt FROM REP_INSTALL_FILE files LEFT JOIN REP_INFO info on files.REP_ID = info.REP_ID left join REP_PROD_INFO prod on files.PRODID = prod.PROD_ID and prod.STATUS = 'E' order by JOB_SEQ desc

SELECT rpTemp.VALUE_DATE, IFNULL(rpTemp.UNIT_VALUE,0) unitValue, IFNULL(rpTemp.UNIT_VALUE_T,0) unitValueT FROM ( SELECT R.VALUE_DATE, R.UNIT_VALUE, R.UNIT_VALUE_T FROM REP_PROD_INDEX R LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R1.PROD_ID PROD_ID, R1.VALUE_DATE, CAST(R1.UNIT_VALUE AS DECIMAL(20,4)) UNIT_VALUE, CAST(R1.UNIT_VALUE_T AS DECIMAL(20,4)) UNIT_VALUE_T, ABS(days(R1.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d'))) minDate FROM REP_PROD_INDEX R1 WHERE R1.STATUS='E' AND R1.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY minDate FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY )RTEMP ON RTEMP.PROD_ID=R.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO rpi ON rpi.PROD_ID = R.PROD_ID WHERE ABS(days(R.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')))=RTEMP.minDate AND rpi.OPEN_MODE='02' UNION ALL SELECT R.VALUE_DATE, R.UNIT_VALUE, R.UNIT_VALUE_T FROM REP_PROD_INDEX R LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO rpi ON rpi.PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rpi.STATUS='E' WHERE R.VALUE_DATE=#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND R.PROD_ID=rpi.PROD_ID AND R.STATUS='E' AND rpi.OPEN_MODE='01') rpTemp

SELECT R.VALUE_DATE, IFNULL(RTEMP.YIELD_7,0) yield7, IFNULL(RTEMP.W_YIELD,0) wYield FROM REP_PROD_INDEX R LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R1.PROD_ID PROD_ID, R1.VALUE_DATE, CAST(R1.YIELD_7*100 AS DECIMAL(20,4)) YIELD_7, CAST(R1.W_YIELD AS DECIMAL(20,4)) W_YIELD, ABS(days(R1.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d'))) minDate FROM REP_PROD_INDEX R1 WHERE R1.STATUS='E' AND R1.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY minDate FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY )RTEMP ON RTEMP.PROD_ID=R.PROD_ID WHERE R.PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND R.STATUS='E' AND ABS(days(R.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')))=RTEMP.minDate

SELECT rt.DICT_VALUE, tt.amt amt, IFNULL(cast(round(cast(tt.amt*100 as float)/tota.B_MARKET_VALUE,2) as decimal(10,2)),0) as precent --占比 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DICT_CODE,DICT_VALUE FROM rep_book_relation) rt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rela.DICT_CODE, SUM(if(rela.FLAG='01',1,-1)*dt.B_MARKET_VALUE) amt, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM rep_book_relation rela LEFT JOIN REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt ON ( dt.SUBJECT_NO LIKE CONCAT(rela.SUBJECT_NO,'%') ) LEFT JOIN REP_BOK_SUBJECT sbt ON dt.SUBJECT_NO = sbt.SUBJECT_NO WHERE dt.DETAIL_DIST ='01' AND rela.SUBJECT_LEVEL = sbt.SUBJECT_LEVEL AND dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.VAL_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' AND sbt.BAL_FLAG = 'D' GROUP BY rela.DICT_CODE, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE UNION ALL SELECT '10' DICT_CODE, dt.B_MARKET_VALUE, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt WHERE dt.DETAIL_DIST ='05' AND dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.VAL_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' UNION ALL SELECT '09' DICT_CODE , IFNULL(tot1.amt1,0)-IFNULL(tot2.amt2,0) amt, tot1.PROD_ID, tot1.VAL_DATE FROM ( SELECT dt.B_MARKET_VALUE amt1 , dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt WHERE dt.DETAIL_DIST ='05' AND dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.VAL_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' )tot1, ( SELECT SUM(if(rela.FLAG='01',1,-1)*dt.B_MARKET_VALUE) amt2, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM rep_book_relation rela LEFT JOIN REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt ON ( dt.SUBJECT_NO LIKE CONCAT(rela.SUBJECT_NO,'%') ) LEFT JOIN REP_BOK_SUBJECT sbt ON dt.SUBJECT_NO = sbt.SUBJECT_NO WHERE dt.DETAIL_DIST ='01' AND rela.SUBJECT_LEVEL = sbt.SUBJECT_LEVEL AND dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.VAL_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' AND sbt.BAL_FLAG = 'D' GROUP BY dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE )tot2 WHERE tot1.PROD_ID = tot2.PROD_ID AND tot1.VAL_DATE = tot2.VAL_DATE )tt ON rt.DICT_CODE = tt.DICT_CODE left join ( SELECT CASE WHEN dt.B_MARKET_VALUE=0 THEN NULL ELSE dt.B_MARKET_VALUE END AS B_MARKET_VALUE, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt WHERE dt.DETAIL_DIST ='05' AND dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.VAL_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' )tota on tota.PROD_ID = tt.PROD_ID AND tota.VAL_DATE = tt.VAL_DATE order by rt.DICT_CODE asc

SELECT '09' DICT_CODE , IFNULL(tot1.amt1,0)-IFNULL(tot2.amt2,0) amt, tot1.PROD_ID, tot1.VAL_DATE FROM ( SELECT dt.B_COST amt1 , dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt WHERE dt.DETAIL_DIST ='05' AND dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.VAL_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' )tot1, ( SELECT SUM(if(rela.FLAG='01',1,-1)*dt.B_COST) amt2, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM rep_book_relation rela LEFT JOIN REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt ON ( dt.SUBJECT_NO LIKE CONCAT(rela.SUBJECT_NO,'%') ) LEFT JOIN REP_BOK_SUBJECT sbt ON dt.SUBJECT_NO = sbt.SUBJECT_NO WHERE dt.DETAIL_DIST ='01' AND rela.SUBJECT_LEVEL = sbt.SUBJECT_LEVEL AND dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.VAL_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' AND sbt.BAL_FLAG = 'D' GROUP BY dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE )tot2 WHERE tot1.PROD_ID = tot2.PROD_ID AND tot1.VAL_DATE = tot2.VAL_DATE )tt ON rt.DICT_CODE = tt.DICT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN dt.B_COST=0 THEN NULL ELSE dt.B_COST END AS B_COST, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt WHERE dt.DETAIL_DIST ='05' AND dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.VAL_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E')tota ON tota.PROD_ID = tt.PROD_ID AND tota.VAL_DATE = tt.VAL_DATE ORDER BY rt.DICT_CODE ASC

select case when ass.bCost is NULL then 0.00 else cast(round(cast(ass.bCost*100 as float)/tota.B_COST,2) as decimal(20,2)) end as precent from( select rvtd.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, rvtd.B_COST bCost, rvtd.PROD_ID, rvtd.SUBJECT_NO, rvtd.rn as LIMIT FROM ( SELECT tmp.*, @rownum := @rownum + 1 rownum as rn /* 虚拟列行标 */ FROM ( /* 数据源 */ SELECT * FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA ORDER BY B_COST DESC ) tmp, /* 定义临时变量池 */ (SELECT @rownum := 0) a ) rvtd LEFT JOIN REP_BOOK_RELATION rela ON rvtd.SUBJECT_NO LIKE CONCAT(rela.SUBJECT_NO,'%') WHERE rvtd.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rvtd.DETAIL_DIST ='01' AND rvtd.VAL_DATE =#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} and rvtd.SUBJECT_NO like '1%' and num_amt is not null and rela.DICT_CODE!='01' and rela.DICT_CODE!='02' and rvtd.B_COST>0 AND (rvtd.SUBJECT_NO NOT IN(SELECT SUBJECT_NO FROM rep_bok_subject) OR rvtd.SUBJECT_NO IN(SELECT SUBJECT_NO FROM rep_bok_subject WHERE rep_bok_subject.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG='02') AND rvtd.SUBJECT_NO NOT IN(SELECT FSUBJECT_ID FROM rep_bok_subject WHERE FSUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)) )ass left join ( SELECT CASE WHEN dt.B_COST=0 THEN NULL ELSE dt.B_COST END AS B_COST, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt WHERE
dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dt.DETAIL_DIST ='05' AND dt.VAL_DATE =#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' )tota on tota.PROD_ID = ass.PROD_ID where ass.LIMIT <=10 and tota.B_COST is not null ORDER BY precent DESC

select ass.LIMIT, ass.subjectName, cast(round(ass.bCost,2) as decimal(20,2)) bCost, tota.B_COST bcostTotal, case when ass.bCost is NULL then 0.00 else cast(round(cast(ass.bCost*100 as float)/tota.B_COST,2) as decimal(20,2)) end as precent --占比(总数不能超过100%) from( select rvtd.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, rvtd.B_COST bCost, rvtd.PROD_ID, rvtd.SUBJECT_NO, rvtd.rn as LIMIT FROM ( SELECT tmp.*, @rownum := @rownum + 1 rownum as rn /* 虚拟列行标 */ FROM ( /* 数据源 */ SELECT * FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA ORDER BY B_COST DESC ) tmp, /* 定义临时变量池 */ (SELECT @rownum := 0) a ) rvtd LEFT JOIN REP_BOOK_RELATION rela ON rvtd.SUBJECT_NO LIKE CONCAT(rela.SUBJECT_NO,'%') WHERE rvtd.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rvtd.DETAIL_DIST ='01' AND rvtd.VAL_DATE =#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} and rvtd.SUBJECT_NO like '1%' and num_amt is not null and rela.DICT_CODE!='01' and rela.DICT_CODE!='02' and rvtd.B_COST>0 AND (rvtd.SUBJECT_NO NOT IN(SELECT SUBJECT_NO FROM rep_bok_subject) OR rvtd.SUBJECT_NO IN(SELECT SUBJECT_NO FROM rep_bok_subject WHERE rep_bok_subject.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG='02') AND rvtd.SUBJECT_NO NOT IN(SELECT FSUBJECT_ID FROM rep_bok_subject WHERE FSUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)) )ass left join ( SELECT CASE WHEN dt.B_COST=0 THEN NULL ELSE dt.B_COST END AS B_COST, dt.PROD_ID, dt.VAL_DATE FROM REP_VAL_TABLE_DATA dt WHERE
dt.PROD_ID =#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dt.DETAIL_DIST ='05' AND dt.VAL_DATE =#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND dt.STATUS = 'E' )tota on tota.PROD_ID = ass.PROD_ID where ass.LIMIT <=10 and tota.B_COST is not null ORDER BY precent DESC

SELECT rpinfo.PROD_ID, rpinfo.PROD_NAME, rpinfo.RAISE_CCY, rpinfo.SET_DATE, rpinfo.MDATE, CAST(round(t2.YIELD_E*100,2)as NUMERIC(20,2)) YIELD_E FROM REP_PROD_INFO rpinfo LEFT JOIN( SELECT * FROM(SELECT REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID, REP_PROD_INDEX.YIELD_E YIELD_E, abs(days(REP_PROD_INDEX.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(rpi.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'))) minDate FROM REP_PROD_INDEX LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO rpi ON rpi.PROD_ID=REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID WHERE REP_PROD_INDEX.STATUS='E' AND REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID,REP_PROD_INDEX.VALUE_DATE,REP_PROD_INDEX.YIELD_E,rpi.MDATE ORDER BY minDate) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)t2 ON rpinfo.PROD_ID=t2.PROD_ID WHERE rpinfo.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rpinfo.STATUS='E' and rpinfo.p_prod_id is null

SELECT rpinfo.PROD_ID, rpinfo.PROD_NAME, rpinfo.RAISE_CCY, rpinfo.SET_DATE, rpinfo.MDATE, CAST(round(t2.UNIT_VALUE,4)as NUMERIC(20,4)) UNIT_VALUE FROM REP_PROD_INFO rpinfo LEFT JOIN( SELECT * FROM(SELECT REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID, REP_PROD_INDEX.UNIT_VALUE UNIT_VALUE, abs(days(REP_PROD_INDEX.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(rpi.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'))) minDate FROM REP_PROD_INDEX LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO rpi ON rpi.PROD_ID=REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID WHERE REP_PROD_INDEX.STATUS='E' AND REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND REP_PROD_INDEX.VALUE_DATE <=rpi.MDATE GROUP BY REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID,REP_PROD_INDEX.VALUE_DATE,REP_PROD_INDEX.UNIT_VALUE,rpi.MDATE ORDER BY minDate) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)t2 ON rpinfo.PROD_ID=t2.PROD_ID WHERE rpinfo.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rpinfo.STATUS='E' and rpinfo.p_prod_id is null

SELECT rpinfo.PROD_ID, rpinfo.PROD_NAME, rpinfo.RAISE_CCY, rpinfo.SET_DATE, rpinfo.MDATE, CAST(round(t2.YIELD_7*100,4)as NUMERIC(20,4)) YIELD_7 FROM REP_PROD_INFO rpinfo LEFT JOIN( SELECT * FROM(SELECT REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID, REP_PROD_INDEX.YIELD_7 YIELD_7, abs(days(REP_PROD_INDEX.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(rpi.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'))) minDate FROM REP_PROD_INDEX LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO rpi ON rpi.PROD_ID=REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID WHERE REP_PROD_INDEX.STATUS='E' AND REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND REP_PROD_INDEX.VALUE_DATE <rpi.MDATE GROUP BY REP_PROD_INDEX.PROD_ID,REP_PROD_INDEX.VALUE_DATE,REP_PROD_INDEX.YIELD_7,rpi.MDATE ORDER BY minDate) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)t2 ON rpinfo.PROD_ID=t2.PROD_ID WHERE rpinfo.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rpinfo.STATUS='E' and rpinfo.p_prod_id is null

SELECT rpi.PROD_ID, rpi.PROD_NAME, rpi.INVEST_PROF_DATE, rpi.DEAL_CAL, rpindex1.PROFIT_TOTAL, cast(rpindex1.YIELD_E*100 as decimal(10,2)) yieldE, feeTemp.sFee, feeTemp.tFee, feeTemp.mFee, feeTemp.fFee, feeTemp.otherFee, SUM(ttotal1.sFeeRate) as sFeeRate, SUM(ttotal1.tFeeRate) as tFeeRate, SUM(ttotal1.mFeeRate) as mFeeRate, SUM(ttotal1.otherFeeRate)as otherFeeRate FROM REP_PROD_INFO rpi LEFT JOIN( select rpindex.PROFIT_TOTAL, rpindex.YIELD_E, rpindex.PROD_ID from ( select rpindex.PROD_ID, min(abs(days(rpindex.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(rpi.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')))) minDate, rpi.MDATE from REP_PROD_INDEX rpindex left join REP_PROD_INFO rpi on rpi.PROD_ID=rpindex.PROD_ID where rpindex.PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by rpindex.PROD_ID, rpi.MDATE ) rpindexTemp left join REP_PROD_INDEX rpindex on rpindexTemp.PROD_ID=rpindex.PROD_ID and abs(days(rpindex.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(rpindexTemp.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')))=rpindexTemp.minDate AND rpindex.STATUS='E' group by PROFIT_TOTAL, YIELD_E, rpindex.PROD_ID ) rpindex1 ON rpindex1.PROD_ID=rpi.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT rp.PROD_ID, sum(case when BOK_TYPE='02' then PAID_FEE else null end) as sFee, sum(case when BOK_TYPE='01' then PAID_FEE else null end) as tFee, sum(case when BOK_TYPE='03' then PAID_FEE else null end) as mFee, sum(case when BOK_TYPE in('04','07','08') then PAID_FEE else null end) as fFee, sum(case when BOK_TYPE in('06','09','10','11','99') then PAID_FEE else null end) as otherFee FROM REP_FEE_TRD rp WHERE rp.PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rp.STATUS='E' GROUP BY rp.PROD_ID) feeTemp ON feeTemp.PROD_ID = rpi.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN( select ttotal.BUSI_ID, cast(SUM(ttotal.sFeeRate*100) as decimal(10,2)) as sFeeRate, cast(SUM(ttotal.tFeeRate*100)as decimal(10,2)) as tFeeRate, cast(SUM(ttotal.mFeeRate*100)as decimal(10,2)) as mFeeRate, cast(SUM(ttotal.otherFeeRate*100)as decimal(10,2)) otherFeeRate from( select rateTemp.BUSI_ID, rateTemp.sFeeRate as sFeeRate, rateTemp.tFeeRate as tFeeRate, rateTemp.mFeeRate as mFeeRate, rateTemp.otherFeeRate as otherFeeRate from ( SELECT rfy.BUSI_ID, case when rfy.BOK_TYPE='02' then rfy.FEE_RATE else null end as sFeeRate, case when rfy.BOK_TYPE='01' then rfy.FEE_RATE else null end as tFeeRate, case when rfy.BOK_TYPE='03' then rfy.FEE_RATE else null end as mFeeRate, case when rfy.BOK_TYPE in('06','09','10','11','99') then rfy.FEE_RATE else null end as otherFeeRate FROM( SELECT rfy1.BUSI_ID BUSI_ID, rfy1.BOK_TYPE, min(abs(days(rfy1.START_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(rpi1.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')))) minDate1, rpi1.MDATE FROM REP_FEE_YIELD rfy1 left join REP_PROD_INFO rpi1 on rpi1.PROD_ID=rfy1.BUSI_ID WHERE rfy1.BUSI_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY rfy1.BUSI_ID, rfy1.BOK_TYPE, rpi1.MDATE )t1 LEFT JOIN REP_FEE_YIELD rfy ON rfy.BUSI_ID=t1.BUSI_ID AND abs(days(rfy.START_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(t1.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')))=t1.minDate1)rateTemp GROUP BY rateTemp.BUSI_ID, sFeeRate, tFeeRate, mFeeRate, otherFeeRate) ttotal GROUP BY ttotal.BUSI_ID) ttotal1 ON ttotal1.BUSI_ID=rpi.PROD_ID WHERE rpi.PROD_ID=#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rpi.STATUS='E' and rpi.p_prod_id is null GROUP BY rpi.PROD_ID, rpi.PROD_NAME, rpi.INVEST_PROF_DATE, rpi.DEAL_CAL, rpindex1.PROFIT_TOTAL, rpindex1.YIELD_E, feeTemp.sFee, feeTemp.tFee, feeTemp.mFee, feeTemp.fFee, feeTemp.otherFee

SELECT rpi.PROD_ID, rpi.PROD_NAME, rpi.INVEST_PROF_DATE, rpi.DEAL_CAL, rpindex1.PROFIT_TOTAL, feeTemp.sFee, feeTemp.tFee, feeTemp.mFee, feeTemp.fFee, feeTemp.otherFee, SUM(ttotal1.sFeeRate) as sFeeRate, SUM(ttotal1.tFeeRate) as tFeeRate, SUM(ttotal1.mFeeRate) as mFeeRate, SUM(ttotal1.otherFeeRate)as otherFeeRate FROM REP_PROD_INFO rpi LEFT JOIN( select rpindex.PROFIT_TOTAL, rpindex.PROD_ID from ( select rpindex.PROD_ID, min(abs(days(rpindex.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(rpi.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')))) minDate, rpi.MDATE from REP_PROD_INDEX rpindex left join REP_PROD_INFO rpi on and abs(days(rpindex.VALUE_DATE)-days(DATE_FORMAT(rpindexTemp.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')))=rpindexTemp.minDate AND rpindex.STATUS='E' group by PROFIT_TOTAL, rpindex.PROD_ID ) rpindex1 ON when BOK_TYPE='03' then PAID_FEE else null end) as mFee, sum(case when BOK_TYPE in('04','07','08') then PAID_FEE else null end) as fFee, sum(case when BOK_TYPE in('06','09','10','11','99') then PAID_FEE else null end) as otherFee FROM REP_FEE_TRD rp WHERE rp.PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rp.STATUS='E' GROUP BY rp.PROD_ID) feeTemp ON feeTemp.PROD_ID = rpi.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN( select cast(SUM(ttotal.otherFeeRate*100)as decimal(10,2)) otherFeeRate from( select rateTemp.BUSI_ID, rateTemp.sFeeRate as sFeeRate, rateTemp.tFeeRate as tFeeRate, rateTemp.mFeeRate as mFeeRate, rateTemp.otherFeeRate as otherFeeRate from ( SELECT rfy.BUSI_ID, case when rfy.BOK_TYPE='02' then rfy.FEE_RATE else null end as sFeeRate, case when rfy.BOK_TYPE='01' then rfy.FEE_RATE else null end as tFeeRate, case when rfy.BOK_TYPE='03' then rfy.FEE_RATE else null end as mFeeRate, case when rfy.BOK_TYPE in('06','09','10','11','99') then rfy.FEE_RATE else null end as otherFeeRate FROM( SELECT
